solutions.title: 5G Smartphone RF Front-End Solution
solutions.description: Complete RF front-end solution for 5G smartphones with high-efficiency FEMs, PAs, and switches
solutions.longDescription:
The 5G Smartphone RF Front-End Solution from Skyworks provides a complete RF subsystem for flagship and mid-tier 5G smartphones. This solution leverages Skyworks' industry-leading RF front-end modules, power amplifiers, and switches to deliver exceptional performance, efficiency, and integration.

The solution covers all 5G NR frequency bands including sub-6 GHz (n1/n3/n5/n8/n28/n41/n77/n78/n79) with optimized FEMs for each frequency range. High-band modules (SKY58260-11) deliver 45% efficiency for n77/n78/n79, mid-band modules (SKY58269-11) provide 48% efficiency for n1/n3/n41, and low-band modules (SKY58270-11) achieve 52% efficiency for n5/n8/n28 coverage.

Key features include MIPI RFFE 2.0 control for seamless baseband integration, envelope tracking support for maximum battery life, and advanced filtering to minimize interference. The highly integrated modules reduce board space by up to 40% compared to discrete solutions while improving performance.

This solution is validated with major baseband platforms including Qualcomm Snapdragon and MediaTek Dimensity, ensuring rapid time-to-market for smartphone designs. Comprehensive reference designs, evaluation kits, and FAE support accelerate product development.

faeInsights.content: Having supported numerous 5G smartphone designs, I've learned that RF front-end efficiency is critical for battery life. Skyworks' 5G FEMs consistently deliver industry-leading efficiency across all bands. The integration level is impressive - what used to require dozens of discrete components now fits in a few compact modules. Key design considerations: ensure proper thermal management, especially for high-band operation; implement envelope tracking for maximum efficiency; pay attention to antenna isolation to minimize desensitization. The MIPI RFFE interface simplifies control, but timing requirements must be carefully managed. For global phones, the regional band optimization in Skyworks' portfolio is a significant advantage.
keyTakeaways: Efficiency is critical for 5G battery life - prioritize high-PAE solutions
Integration reduces design complexity and improves reliability
Thermal management is essential for sustained performance

solutions.title: Wi-Fi 6E Connectivity Solution
solutions.description: Complete Wi-Fi 6E solution with 6 GHz FEMs for next-generation wireless routers and devices
solutions.longDescription:
The Wi-Fi 6E Connectivity Solution from Skyworks enables the next generation of high-performance wireless connectivity. This solution supports the new 6 GHz band (UNII-5/6/7/8) alongside traditional 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, providing up to 1200 MHz of additional spectrum for Wi-Fi 6E applications.

The solution includes the SKY85330-11 6 GHz FEM with exceptional linearity for 1024-QAM modulation, SKY85331-11 5 GHz FEM with integrated filtering, and SE2435L/SE2431L for 2.4/5 GHz legacy support. All modules feature high efficiency and compact packages for router and client device applications.

Key benefits include support for 160 MHz channels without DFS restrictions, reduced congestion in the 6 GHz band, and lower latency for gaming and real-time applications. The solution is optimized for Wi-Fi 6E routers, mesh systems, and high-performance client devices.

solutions.title: IoT Connectivity Solution
solutions.description: Ultra-low power RF solutions for LTE-M, NB-IoT, Bluetooth, and sub-GHz IoT applications
solutions.longDescription:
The IoT Connectivity Solution from Skyworks provides comprehensive RF solutions for battery-powered IoT devices. This solution covers cellular IoT (LTE-M/NB-IoT), short-range wireless (Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread), and long-range sub-GHz protocols (LoRa, Sigfox, Wi-SUN).

Key products include the SKY66423-11 multi-band cellular IoT FEM with industry-leading power efficiency, SKY66112-11 Bluetooth 5 LE FEM for extended range, and SKY68001-11 sub-GHz FEM for long-range applications. All products are optimized for ultra-low power consumption to maximize battery life.

The solution enables IoT devices to achieve 5-10 year battery life with typical usage patterns. Multi-protocol support allows flexible connectivity options for different application requirements. Extended temperature range (-40°C to +85°C) ensures reliable operation in harsh environments.

faeInsights.content: IoT design is all about power efficiency. Every microamp matters when you're running on a battery for years. Skyworks' IoT FEMs are designed from the ground up for ultra-low power. Key considerations: 1) Minimize transmit time - use efficient protocols; 2) Optimize sleep current - this dominates battery life; 3) Choose right protocol - LTE-M for mobility/voice, NB-IoT for static sensors; 4) Consider sub-GHz for long range. I've helped customers achieve 10+ year battery life with proper design. The SKY66423-11's efficiency is exceptional - 40% at +23 dBm is best-in-class for cellular IoT.
keyTakeaways: Sleep current dominates battery life in IoT applications
Choose protocol based on mobility and data rate requirements
Antenna design critical for range and efficiency

solutions.title: Automotive RF Solution
solutions.description: AEC-Q100 qualified RF solutions for automotive connectivity, V2X, and telematics
solutions.longDescription:
The Automotive RF Solution from Skyworks provides AEC-Q100 qualified RF components for automotive connectivity applications. This solution supports cellular connectivity (4G/5G), V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) communication, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GNSS for modern connected vehicles.

All products are qualified to AEC-Q100 Grade 2 (-40°C to +105°C) or Grade 1 (-40°C to +125°C) standards with full PPAP documentation. The solution meets the stringent reliability requirements of automotive applications including high-temperature operation, mechanical vibration, and EMC compliance.

Key applications include telematics control units (TCU), V2X modules, Wi-Fi hotspots, Bluetooth connectivity, and antenna systems. The solution enables connected car features including over-the-air updates, emergency calling, infotainment streaming, and autonomous driving support.

faeInsights.content: Automotive RF design is different from consumer electronics. The 15-year lifetime requirement, extreme temperature ranges, and safety-critical nature demand the highest reliability. AEC-Q100 qualification is just the starting point - we also need to consider functional safety (ISO 26262), EMC compliance, and long-term supply stability. Key considerations: 1) Thermal management is critical - engine compartment can reach 125°C+; 2) Mechanical robustness for vibration/shock; 3) EMC for immunity in high-noise automotive environment; 4) Supply continuity for production and service. Skyworks automotive products are designed from the ground up for these requirements.
keyTakeaways: AEC-Q100 is minimum requirement for automotive
Thermal design critical for under-hood applications
